# dokploy_organization (Data Source)

Fetches a single organization from Dokploy by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```hcl
# Look up organization by ID
data "dokploy_organization" "by_id" {
  organization_id = "abc123"
}

# Look up organization by name
data "dokploy_organization" "by_name" {
  name = "my-org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The organization name to look up. Mutually exclusive with organization_id.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID to look up. Mutually exclusive with name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the organization.
- `logo` (String) The logo URL of the organization.
